name: singlet_spatial_deconv_mapping_spot_celltype_proportions
title: Cell type proportions for spots and bins
description: Estimates the fraction of each reference cell type in every spot or bin of a spatial transcriptomics dataset from a labelled single-cell or single-nucleus reference of the same tissue, and writes a unit-by-type proportion matrix with the ordered type names and the fitted reference model. Needs raw UMI counts in layers/counts and gene identifiers shared with the reference. The default cell2location is the only method with posterior intervals; rctd and nnls are fast deterministic baselines. Units smaller than a Visium spot (55 micrometres) are unvalidated. Do not use for single-cell data, for labelling individual cells, for reference-free discovery, or without a matched reference.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

reference.description: Labelled reference dataset (path, URI or workspace handle); read only. Needs layers/counts and var/gene_id.

label_key.description: Reference obs column with cell-type labels; at least two types with enough cells are required.

method.description: Estimator. cell2location is the default; rctd and nnls are deterministic and need no GPU.

feature_key.description: Boolean var column present in both datasets selecting genes; null uses all genes shared after filtering.

min_cells_per_type.description: Reference types with fewer cells are dropped and listed in types_dropped.

max_epochs.description: Training epochs for the reference and spatial models; null keeps method defaults. Ignored by rctd and nnls.

cell2location.description: Options used only when method is cell2location.

batch_key.description: Reference obs column naming donor or study; set it to estimate signatures by NB regression with batch, otherwise class means.

cells_per_spot_key.description: Spatial obs column with a per-unit cell count from histology or nuclei; replaces n_cells_per_location.

n_cells_per_location.description: Expected cells per unit when cells_per_spot_key is null; a histology-derived value is preferred.

detection_alpha.description: Detection-efficiency hyperprior; larger values constrain its variation across units more tightly.

amortised.description: Infer abundances with the trained encoder at models/cell2location_encoder; fails if the encoder is absent.

num_samples.description: Posterior draws per unit used for the summaries.

proportion_summary.description: Posterior summary written as proportions: q05 or q50 of abundance, normalised per unit, or mean of per-draw composition.

write_posterior.description: Also write abundance q05 and q50 and the 5th and 95th percentiles of per-draw composition.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available. rctd always uses cpu.

seed.description: Random seed for training and posterior sampling; rctd and nnls are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/cell2location_proportions. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, proportion_summary, n_units, n_reference_cells, n_types, types_dropped, n_shared_genes, median_top_type_fraction, converged, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device and the epoch counts that would apply.
